title: UI kit viewport & browser QC — responsive triage for Safari/Firefox/mobile
creator: Ava Kumar
description: Goal: Run a focused QC pass and triage workflow for the UI kit across Safari (macOS, iOS WebView), Firefox (desktop), and common mobile viewports. Scope covers tokens, primary/secondary buttons, data tables (responsive collapse behavior + row actions), and chart embeds (axis labels + tooltips). Background: recent token refactor and new chart legend updates introduced subtle layout regressions in non-Chromium browsers and at narrow widths. We need reproducible bug reports, severity, and concrete fixes (design or engineering).
acceptance_criteria: Comprehensive test matrix executed for listed components across target browsers and viewports
All high/critical issues triaged with owner, repro, and PR or design change linked
Design decisions documented for any intentional cross-browser compromises
Regression snapshots added to visual test suite and e2e checks updated where applicable
testing_matrix: Desktop macOS: Safari 16+, Firefox 115+, Chrome latest
iOS: Mobile Safari (13+), iOS WebView (embedded app) via BrowserStack
priority_rationale: P1 — token refactor impacts several customers using Dedicated and Private deployments; visual regressions could affect usability for tables and charts.
triage_plan: 1) Run scripted checklist across matrix and capture screenshots + DOM snippets. 2) Create reproducible Linear issues with severity tags and assign to ENG or DES owner. 3) For token-related failures, freeze token set and open a rollback PR + design proposal. 4) Verify fixes in staging and record snapshots. 5) Post-mortem note with root cause and mitigation.
notes_and_findings: 2026-03-10: Initial sweep found 13 failures across browsers — most concentrated in Safari and Firefox. Patterns: focus ring sizing, button baseline alignment, table overflow with sticky headers, chart axis wrapping.

Button focus: Safari showed doubled focus ring offset when default outline + new token shadow combined. Probable cause: token shadow value applied on focus state in addition to browser outline. Temporary mitigation: reset outline when token shadow present (design-approved compromise).
Tables: In Firefox, responsive row collapse animation caused horizontal scrollbar at 480px due to calc() + min-width interplay on action cell. Repro repo clip added to ENG-21011.

Charts: D3 SVG label wrapping differs between WebKit and Gecko — axis labels truncated in Firefox. Suggested fix: switch to textLength with ellipsize fallback and increase chart padding on non-Chromium browsers.

Tokens: color token semantic changes (neutral-700 -> neutral-600) produced contrast regressions for disabled buttons. Security/accessibility flagged; filing accessibility follow-up with contrast targets.
